ei.title: Daniel's Journey from Anxiety to Relief
ei.subject: 6월_2026 고1 모의고사
ei.lesson: Daniel's Journey from Anxiety to Relief

fullPassage: Daniel was on his way to the train station for a business trip. He was riding a bus when it suddenly stopped. The driver announced, "We have a mechanical problem." Daniel grew nervous about missing his train. Without hesitation, he got off the bus and took a taxi to the station. Still, he kept worrying about not making it in time. When he finally reached the station, he found out the train was delayed by ten minutes. Once he settled into his seat, he let out a long breath of relief.

questions.passage: Daniel was on his way to the train station for a business trip. He was riding a bus when it suddenly stopped. The driver (A)[announced / whispered], "We have a mechanical problem." Daniel grew (B)[nervous / calm] about missing his train. Without hesitation, he got off the bus and took a taxi to the station. Still, he kept worrying about not making it in time. When he finally reached the station, he found out the train was delayed by ten minutes. Once he settled into his seat, he let out a long breath of (C)[relief / hesitation].
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 운전기사가 기계적 문제가 있다고 알렸고(announced), Daniel은 기차를 놓칠까 초조해했으며(nervous), 자리에 앉자 안도(relief)의 긴 한숨을 내쉬었다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② announced — nervous — relief: 원문과 일치 ←정답
❌ ① hesitation(망설임): relief 자리에 부적절
❌ ③ calm(차분한): nervous의 반의어
❌ ④ whispered(속삭였다): announced의 반의어
det.tip: announce = 알리다, nervous = 초조한, relief = 안도

questions.passage: Daniel was on his way to the train station for a business trip. He was riding a bus when it (A)[suddenly / gradually] stopped. The driver announced, "We have a mechanical problem." Daniel grew nervous about missing his train. Without hesitation, he got off the bus and took a taxi to the station. Still, he kept (B)[worrying / celebrating] about not making it in time. When he finally reached the station, he found out the train was (C)[delayed / advanced] by ten minutes. Once he settled into his seat, he let out a long breath of relief.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 버스가 갑자기(suddenly) 멈췄고, 그는 계속 걱정하며(worrying), 기차가 10분 지연되었다(delayed)는 것을 알았다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① advanced(앞당겨진): delayed의 반의어
❌ ② gradually(서서히): suddenly의 반의어
✅ ③ suddenly — worrying — delayed: 원문과 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ celebrating(축하하는): worrying의 반의어
det.tip: suddenly = 갑자기, worry = 걱정하다, delay = 지연시키다

questions.passage: Daniel was on his way to the train station for a business trip. He was riding a bus when it suddenly stopped. The driver announced, "We have a (A)[mechanical / trivial] problem." Daniel grew nervous about missing his train. Without hesitation, he got off the bus and took a taxi to the station. Still, he kept worrying about not making it in time. When he finally (B)[reached / missed] the station, he found out the train was delayed by ten minutes. Once he (C)[settled / abandoned] into his seat, he let out a long breath of relief.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 기계적인(mechanical) 문제가 있었고, 마침내 역에 도착했을 때(reached), 자리에 자리를 잡았다(settled).
det.analysis:
❌ ① abandoned(포기했다): settled의 반의어
❌ ② missed(놓쳤다): reached의 반의어
❌ ③ trivial(사소한): mechanical과 의미축 다름
✅ ④ mechanical — reached — settled: 원문과 일치 ←정답
det.tip: mechanical = 기계적인, reach = 도착하다, settle = 자리잡다

questions.passage: Daniel was on his way to the train station for a business trip. He was riding a bus when it suddenly stopped. The driver announced, "We have a mechanical problem." Daniel grew ①<u>nervous</u> about missing his train. Without ②<u>confidence</u>, he got off the bus and took a taxi to the station. Still, he kept ③<u>worrying</u> about not making it in time. When he finally reached the station, he found out the train was delayed by ten minutes. Once he settled into his seat, he let out a long breath of ④<u>relief</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② confidence(자신감) → hesitation(망설임): '망설임 없이' 버스에서 내린 것이므로 hesitation이 맞다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① nervous(초조한): 기차 놓칠까 초조 — 적절
❌ ② confidence → hesitation: 원문은 Without hesitation ←정답
✅ ③ worrying(걱정하는): 계속 걱정 — 적절
✅ ④ relief(안도): 긴 안도의 숨 — 적절

questions.passage: Daniel was on his way to the train station for a business trip. He was riding a bus when it suddenly ①<u>stopped</u>. The driver ②<u>announced</u>, "We have a mechanical problem." Daniel grew nervous about missing his train. Without hesitation, he got off the bus and took a taxi to the station. Still, he kept worrying about not making it in time. questions.stem: 다음 글의 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ canceled(취소된) → delayed(지연된): 기차가 10분 지연되었다는 사실을 알았으므로 delayed가 맞다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① stopped(멈췄다): 버스가 멈춤 — 적절
✅ ② announced(알렸다): 기사가 알림 — 적절
❌ ③ canceled → delayed: 원문은 delayed by ten minutes ←정답
✅ ④ settled(자리잡았다): 자리에 앉음 — 적절

questions.passage: Daniel was on his way to the train station for a business trip. He was riding a bus when it ①<u>gradually</u> stopped. The driver announced, "We have a ②<u>mechanical</u> problem." When he finally ③<u>reached</u> the station, he found out the train was delayed by ten minutes. Once he settled into his seat, he let out a long ④<u>breath</u> of relief.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① gradually(서서히) → suddenly(갑자기): 버스가 갑자기 멈춘 상황이므로 suddenly가 맞다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① gradually → suddenly: 원문은 it suddenly stopped ←정답
✅ ② mechanical(기계적인): 기계 문제 — 적절
✅ ③ reached(도착했다): 역에 도착 — 적절
✅ ④ breath(숨): 안도의 숨 — 적절

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 announced의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: announced = 알렸다, declared = 선언했다/알렸다 → 동의어

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 nervous의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: nervous = 초조한, anxious = 불안한/초조한 → 동의어
det.analysis:
❌ ① confident(자신감 있는): 반의어
❌ ② cheerful(쾌활한): 무관
❌ ③ relaxed(편안한): 반의어
✅ ④ anxious(불안한): nervous의 동의어 ←정답

questions.passage: Daniel was on his way to the train station for a business trip. He was riding a bus when it suddenly stopped. The driver announced, "We have a mechanical problem." When he finally <u>reached</u> the station, he found out the train was delayed by ten minutes. Once he settled into his seat, he let out a long breath of relief.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 reached의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: reached = 도착했다, arrived at = 도착했다 → 동의어
det.analysis:
✅ ① arrived at(~에 도착했다): reached의 동의어 ←정답
❌ ② departed from(~에서 출발했다): 반의어
❌ ③ passed by(지나쳤다): 다른 의미
❌ ④ looked for(찾았다): 무관
det.tip: reach = arrive at = get to = 도착하다

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 stopped의 의미와 가장 먼 것은?

det.korean: stopped = 멈췄다 ↔ continued = 계속했다
det.analysis:
✅ ① halted(멈췄다): 동의어
❌ ② continued(계속했다): stopped의 반의어 ←정답
✅ ③ paused(잠시 멈췄다): 유사어

questions.passage: Daniel was on his way to the train station for a business trip. He was riding a bus when it suddenly stopped. The driver announced, "We have a mechanical problem." Daniel grew nervous about missing his train. Without hesitation, he got off the bus and took a taxi to the station. Still, he kept worrying about not making it in time. When he finally reached the station, he found out the train was delayed by ten minutes. Once he settled into his seat, he let out a long breath of <u>relief</u>.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 relief의 의미와 가장 먼 것은?

det.korean: relief = 안도 ↔ distress = 고통/괴로움
det.analysis:
✅ ① comfort(편안함): 유사어
✅ ② ease(안도/편안함): 유사어
❌ ③ distress(고통/괴로움): relief의 반의어 ←정답
✅ ④ solace(위안): 유사어

questions.passage:
(A) He was <u>riding</u> a bus when it suddenly stopped.

(B) She has been <u>riding</u> horses since she was five years old.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 riding이 (A)에서 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A)에서 riding은 버스를 승객으로 타고 이동하다(traveling as a passenger)는 의미. (B)에서는 말 위에 앉아 조종하다(sitting on top and controlling)는 의미.
det.analysis:
✅ ① traveling as a passenger(승객으로 이동): (A)의 버스 탑승 맥락 ←정답
❌ ② sitting on top and controlling(위에 앉아 조종): (B)의 승마 맥락
❌ ③ managing skillfully(능숙하게 다루다): 무관
❌ ④ floating on water(물 위에 떠 있다): 무관
det.tip: ride a bus = 버스를 타다 (승객), ride a horse = 말을 타다 (조종)

questions.stem:

"a pause or delay before doing something because of fear or doubt"

det.korean: "두려움이나 의심 때문에 무언가를 하기 전의 멈춤 또는 지연" = hesitation(망설임)
det.analysis:
❌ ① ambition(야망): 무관
❌ ② decision(결정): 무관
❌ ③ enthusiasm(열정): 무관
✅ ④ hesitation(망설임): 영영풀이와 일치 ←정답

The driver __________ (announce), "We have a mechanical problem."

det.korean: announce(알리다) → announced(알렸다): 과거 시제 문맥이므로 과거형이 필요.
det.analysis: ✅ announced: 과거형. 글 전체가 과거 시제

questions.passage: Without __________ (hesitate), he got off the bus and took a taxi to the station.
questions.stem:

Without __________ (hesitate), he got off the bus and took a taxi to the station.

det.korean: hesitate(망설이다, 동사) → hesitation(망설임, 명사): Without + 명사 구조이므로 명사형이 필요.
det.analysis: ✅ hesitation: Without + 명사. 동사 hesitate → 명사 hesitation
